sam_partnerships: Heads-up: ArmCloud APAC PO (2026-AC-7789) keeps getting rejected by marketplace ingestion for vendor entity mismatch. Customer expects deployment this week, finance is blocked. Can ops/legal help? :pray:

anita_finance: Share the PO id and the rejection payload please. I need to see what bookkeeping expects.

marketplace-bot: ingestion_error: vendor_entity_mismatch; received="ArmCloud International"; expected="ArmCloud APAC Pty Ltd"

sam_partnerships: PO 2026-AC-7789. Screenshot uploaded to the ticket.

claire_marketplaceops: Marketplace ingestion enforces exact vendor alias match. We can add an alias mapping but audit requires a signed vendor alias confirmation (or amendment) before we persist it. Without that the webhook auto-rejects.

leo_arm: Leo from ArmCloud — our APAC commercial entity is separate. We can sign a short alias confirmation letter but counsel turnaround is ~48h. Is there a temporary acceptance route to avoid stalling the customer?

raj_legal: I can draft a narrow one-paragraph amendment that authorizes ArmCloud APAC Pty Ltd as a billing alias. It won't touch commercial terms or IP. Should be quick to sign.

gabe_sales: Customer timeline is EOW. If legal gets the amendment to us today, sales will push procurement on their side. Otherwise we might need to accept a manual invoice and backfill the PO (bad for automated revenue recognition).

anita_finance: Manual invoice is a fallback; prefer to keep marketplace PO flow. Finance needs the signed doc for audit before we update vendor alias and re-run ingestion.

claire_marketplaceops: Operational workaround: if you provide the exact alias string + tax id + contact email we can pre-stage a mapping and open a temporary exception ticket to allow ingestion for this specific PO while we wait for the signed amendment. Must match exactly (case/punctuation). Example we need: po_id=2026-AC-7789; vendor_alias="ArmCloud APAC Pty Ltd"; tax_id=APAC-XX-12345; contact=payments@armcloud-apac.com

leo_arm: Confirm those values are correct. I'll escalate to counsel to sign. Raj, can you drop a template?

raj_legal: Draft uploaded to MP-4527 and DM'd to Leo. One-paragraph, vendor-friendly amendment.

marketplace-bot: Ticket MP-4527 created: "Alias confirmation pre-stage for PO 2026-AC-7789" assigned to claire_marketplaceops.

sam_partnerships: Agreed plan: Raj drafts -> vendor signs -> Anita receives signed doc -> Claire pre-stages mapping and retries ingestion -> Gabe updates customer. Fallback: manual invoice.

gabe_sales: I'll message the customer and set expectations. If counsel delays, I'll request manual invoice approval from finance.

claire_marketplaceops: I'll add ingestion logs to MP-4527 and coordinate with eng if a manual override is needed. Update ticket status when pre-stage is done.

anita_finance: Please cc me on MP-4527 when the signed amendment is uploaded. I need it for the audit trail before alias update.

leo_arm: Thanks all, prioritizing with counsel. Will report back within 24h or sooner if signed.

marketplace-bot: MP-4527 status: in_progress -> awaiting_vendor_signature

sam_partnerships: Ping here once signed or if vendor counsel requests language tweaks.
